publications.name: Latari Elves Infantry Command Unit Upgrade

rules.name: Leonx Riders - Melee Surge Ability
rules.description: 2 Surge : Add a Hit.

rules.name: Leonx Riders - Melee Unique Surge Ability
rules.description: 2 Surge : Add a Mortal Strike.

rules.name: Aliana of Summersong - Melee Ability
rules.description: Add a Mortal Strike.

rules.name: Aliana of Summersong - Melee Unique Surge Ability
rules.description: 1 Surge : Add a Hit.

rules.name: Lana's Wildstalkers
rules.description: After deployment, you may remove 1 allied unit of Leonx Riders from the play area, then redeploy that unit.

rules.name: Aymhelin Scions - Melee / Ranged Surge Ability
rules.description: 2 Surge : The defender receives 1 stun token.

rules.name: Aymhelin Scions - Passive Ability
rules.description: When you collide with an enemy or an enemy collides with you, that enemy receives 1 immobilize token.

rules.name: Maegan Cyndewin - Melee / Ranged Surge+ Ability
rules.description: Each enemy at range 1-[Unstable Rune] of the defender suffers 1 damage per Surge spent.

rules.name: High Circle at Lithelin
rules.description: Each infantry unit from the Latari Elves in your army can equip 1 upgrade from the Latari Elves with "Sorceress" in its name, in addition to its available upgrades.

rules.name: Deepwood Archers - Ranged Unique Surge Ability
rules.description: After this attack, perform a 1 speed Shift. This Shift cannot be used to disengage.

rules.name: Dreamweaver Sorceress - Skill Ability
rules.description: Exhaust this card to choose an enemy at range 1-3. That enemy receives 1 stun token.

rules.name: Champion of the Starplain
rules.description: After setup, each ally that is at range 1-5 of Prince Faolan or has a champion upgrade equipped receives 1 inspiration token.

rules.name: Prince Faolan - Melee Ability
rules.description: Add [Stable Rune] blue dice. After rerolls, you must remove 1 die.

rules.name: Prince Faolan - Passive Ability
rules.description:
When you perform a march, you may treat it as modified by 1 of the following: turn, wheel, charge.

When you would perform a speed-3 March, you may perform 3 speed-1 Marches, instead. If you do, cancel your modifer dial.

rules.name: Storm Sorceress - Skill Ability
rules.description: Roll 1 blue die. For each Surge, choose an enemy at range 1-3. Each chosen enemy suffers [Unstable Rune] damage.

rules.name: Verdant Sorceress - Skill ability
rules.description: Choose an ally at range 1-[Natural Rune] of overgrown terrain. That ally may remove up to [Natural Rune] banes.

rules.name: Ventala Skirmishers - Ranged Ability
rules.description: If the defender is at range 1-3, add 1 blue die.

rules.name: Ventala Skirmishers - Passive Ability
rules.description: When you perform a march, you may decrease its speed by 1 or treat it as modified by a turn.

rules.name: Darnati Warriors- Melee Ability
rules.description: After rerolls, you must remove 1 die.

rules.name: Darnati Warriors - Melee Surge Ability
rules.description: Gain Lethal 1 for this Melee Attack.

rules.name: Hunter's Guile - Melee / Ranged Ability
rules.description: If you are at range 1-[Natural Rune] of overgrown terrain, you may replace1 of your dice with a white die.

rules.name: Flank Fire - Passive Ability
rules.description: You can draw line of sight and perform Ranged Attacks using your side firing arcs.

rules.name: Flank Fire - Ranged Ability
rules.description: If you drew line of sight from your side firing arc or terrain you occupy, your threat is equal to the number of your partial and full ranks. Also, your number of ranks for rerolls is equal to the number of trays in your front rank.

rules.name: Hedge Shroud - Passive Ability
rules.description: While defending at range 1-[Unnatural Rune] of overgrown terrain, you may exhaust this card to treat your defense as [Natural Rune].

rules.name: Lay of the Land - Passive Ability
rules.description: After you perform a Shift, you may perform a speed-1 Shift. This Shift cannot be used to disengage. Limit once per round.

rules.name: Marching Starling - Passive Ability
rules.description: When you perform a March, you may treat it as modified by a Turn.

rules.name: Rallying Starling - Skill Ability
rules.description: Each other ally at range 1-3 may choose to either remove 1 bane or ready 1 upgrade card.

rules.name: Tactical Starling - Passive Ability
rules.description: You do not receive panic tokens for disengaging from enemies.

rules.name: Greenwatch Herald - Passive Ability
rules.description:
You may exhaust this card while an ally at range 1-[Natural Rune] of overgrown terrain is attacking to cause that ally to reroll 1 die.

After deployment, place 1 overgrowth token at range 3-5 of your unit. Abilities treat this token as overgrown terrain, even if this card is exhausted.

rules.name: Herald of the Twisting Gale - Passive Ability
rules.description: When you collide with an enemy or an enemy collides with you, you may exhaust this card to preform a Reform.

rules.name: Herald of the Twisting Gale - Skill Ability
rules.description: Choose another ally at range 1-3. You may exhaust this card to cause that ally to preform a Reform.

rules.name: Warsong Herald - Passive Ability
rules.description:
When another ally is attacking an enemy you are engaged with, that ally may reroll 1 die.

You do not suffer the morale test for being engaged with the defender of a Ranged Attack.

rules.name: Maegan Cyndewin - Melee / Ranged Ability
rules.description:
For this attack, you may gain either:
-Surge+: Each enemy at range 1-[Unstable Rune] of the defender suffers 1 damage per Surge spent.
-Lethal [Natural Rune]

rules.name: Maegan Cyndewin - Melee / Ranged Ability
rules.description:
For this attack, you may gain either:
-Surge+: Each enemy at range 1-[Unstable Rune] of the defender suffers 1 damage per Surge spent.
-Lethal [Natural Rune]

rules.name: Latari Champion - Skill Ability
rules.description: Choose an enemy at range 1-3 and in light of sight. That enemy must perform a speed-1 March.

rules.name: Avenger of Latariana - Passive Ability
rules.description: After defending against a Melee Attack, if your command tool is unrevealed, you may exhaust this card to perform a Melee Attack. If you do, reveal your command tool and you cannot activate during this round.

rules.name: Blackthorn Assasin - Passive Ability
rules.description: After deployment, place 3 blight tokens on this card.

rules.name: Blackthorn Assasin - Melee / Ranged Ability
rules.description: You may remove 1 blight token from this card. If you do, the defender receives 1 blight token.

rules.name: Firstblade of Lord Aenoth - Skill Ability
rules.description: Choose an enemy at range 1-3 and in line of sight. That enemy must perform a speed-1 March.

rules.name: Prince Faolan (Infantry Upgrade) - Melee Ranged Ability
rules.description: You may replace 1 die with a white die.

rules.name: Prince Faolan (Infantry Upgrade) - Passive Ability
rules.description: During your activation, you may treat your first March as modified by 1 of the following: Turn, Wheel, or Charge. If you do, you cannot disengage during this activation.

rules.name: Prince Faolan (Cavalry Upgrade) - Melee Ranged Ability
rules.description: You may replace 1 die with a white die.

rules.name: Prince Faolan (Cavalry Upgrade) - Passive Ability
rules.description: During your activation, you may treat your first March as modified by 1 of the following: Turn, Wheel, or Charge. If you do, you cannot disengage during this activation.

rules.name: Storm Sorceress - Skill Ability
rules.description: Roll 1 blue die. For each Surge, choose an enemy at range 1-3. Each chosen enemy suffers [Unstable Rune] damage.

rules.name: Verdant Sorceress - Skill ability
rules.description: Choose an ally at range 1-[Natural Rune] of overgrown terrain. That ally may remove up to [Natural Rune] banes.

rules.name: Dreamweaver Sorceress - Skill Ability
rules.description: Exhaust this card to choose an enemy at range 1-3. That enemy receives 1 stun token.

rules.name: Warden of Horn and Branch - Skill Ability
rules.description: Choose an enemy at range 1-5 and in line of sight. Roll 1 blue die for each other "Ventala" ally at range 1-3 of that enemy that has line of sight to that enemy. For each Surge, that enemy suffers 2 damage.

rules.name: Packleader's Spear - Melee Ability
rules.description: You may exhaust this card to gain Lethal 3 for this Melee Attack.

rules.name: Packleader's Spear - Passive Ability
rules.description: If this card is exhausted, after an enemy engaged with you is destroyed, ready this card. This card cannot be readied otherwise

rules.name: Malcorne's Bequest - Passive Ability
rules.description: After energy tokens are cast during setup and the End Phase, you may recast 1 energy token with active or inactive [Unstable Rune] runes. Then, you may exhaust this card to recast 1 energy token.

rules.name: The Spirit Sword - Melee Surge Ability
rules.description: 2 Surges: Receive 1 inspiration token.

rules.name: The Spirit Sword - Passive Ability
rules.description: While you are defending, you may spend 1 of your inspiration tokens to remove 1 dice icon of your choice.

rules.name: Fertile Soil - Passive Ability
rules.description: Before each End Phase, if [Natural Rune] is 2 or more, you may remove 1 wound.

rules.name: Ambush Predator - Passive Ability
rules.description: Enemy Ranged Attack cannot target you.

rules.name: Ambush Predator - Melee Ability
rules.description: If this is your first Melee Attack, you gain Lethal X for this Melee Attack, where X is the current round. Then, discard this card.

rules.name: Martial Magic - Passive Ability
rules.description:
Your Ranged Attack can target enemies at range 1-3 only.
Your defense is increased by 1.

rules.name: Vicious Roots - Melee / Ranged Ability
rules.description: If the defender is at range 1-3, you may discard this card and receive 1 immobilize token. If you do, the defender discards all boons, then receives 1 immobilize token.

rules.name: Wildcall's Instinct - Passive Ability
rules.description: When you perform a March or Shift, you may treat it as modified by a Turn.

rules.name: Arcane Mastery - Skill Ability
rules.description: Choose an enemy at range 1-[Unstable Rune]. That enemy receives 1 panic token. Choose an enemy at range 1-[Natural Rune]. Remove 1 boon from that enemy. Choose an enemy at range 1-[Stable Rune]. That enemy receives 1 stun token.

rules.name: Etharyon of the Ailatar - Skill Ability
rules.description: Choose an ally at range 1-3. That unit may perform a Reform or a speed-1 Shift. It may treat this shift as modified by a turn.

rules.name: Legendary Prowess - Melee Ability
rules.description: If the defender is not engaged with other units, you may replace 1 die with a white or red die.

rules.name: Legendary Prowess - Passive Ability
rules.description: While you are defending, enemies do not add an extra die for flanking you.

rules.name: Valor of the Fallen - Skill Ability
rules.description: Choose 1 ally at range 1-5. If you have at least 1 inspiration token, that unit receives 1 inspiration token.

rules.name: Pathwalker's Amulet - Passive Ability
rules.description: While defending, you may discard this card to gain Protected [Natural Rune] for this attack.

rules.name: Bolo Nets - Skill Ability
rules.description: Discard this card to choose an unengaged enemy at range 1-3 and in line of sight. That unit receives 1 immobilize token.

rules.name: Frontline Aymhelin Scion - Melee / Ranged Ability
rules.description: You may exhaust this card to cause the defender to receive 1 stun token.

rules.name: Frontline Aymhelin Scion - Surge Ability
rules.description: If this card is exhausted, ready this card.

rules.name: Support Aymhelin Scion - Passive Ability
rules.description:
You must deploy this figure to your back rank.

After your activation, if you are at range 1-[Natural Rune] of overgrown terrain, you may perform a speed-1 Shift. This Shift cannot be used to disengage.
